description: Interactive vis-network concept map of quantum gate families and their relationships. Nodes represent gate categories (Pauli, Phase, Hadamard, Multi-Qubit, Universal Set) and individual gates (X, Y, Z, H, S, T, CNOT, CZ, Toffoli). Solid edges indicate is-a/includes relationships; dashed edges show mathematical equivalences (S²=Z, T²=S, CNOT↔CZ). Clicking a node displays the gate's matrix, description, and key algebraic properties.

learningObjectives: Classify quantum gates by family (Pauli, Phase, Hadamard, multi-qubit)
Explain the algebraic relationships S²=Z and T²=S
Identify why {H, T, CNOT} form a universal gate set
